# Bhavya Jain

> Research Associate in Cryptography at Namo Labs, founder of AlterBlock, and builder of verifiable systems using zero-knowledge proofs, post-quantum cryptography, and Rust.

Bhavya Jain builds verifiable systems where cryptography replaces trust in the operator. A Research Associate in Cryptography at Namo Labs and founder of AlterBlock, he works across post-quantum migration, zero-knowledge identity, and Rust-based P2P infrastructure. His projects span proof-backed communication, quantitative trading, autonomous code audits, and EVM vaults. A published G-CARED 2025 researcher, he is a final-year B.Tech CSE student with a 9.00/10 CGPA.

Seeking internships and early-career roles in verifiable infrastructure: zkVMs, proof markets, ZK identity, and post-quantum migration.

Profile updated October 1, 2026 from the candidate's supplied LinkedIn profile PDF, Profile (9).pdf. Previously supplied engineering details are retained where the latest profile does not replace them. Results are candidate-reported. Project dates absent from the latest profile are not inferred.

## Work experience

### Namo Labs — Post-Quantum Migration

Research Associate — Cryptography, Namo Labs. August 2026 – Present. New Delhi.

Researching post-quantum cryptography migration for Namo Labs products. Evaluating candidate PQC protocols and proposing protocol-by-protocol replacements for classical cryptographic standards ahead of the quantum threat.

Technologies: Post-Quantum Cryptography, Protocol Evaluation, PQC Migration, Cryptographic Standards.

### Kambria — KAT Tokenomics

Backend Developer, System Prototyping DAO. May 2026 – Present. New Delhi.

Building the Credit → Karma → KAT tokenomics backend for a multi-tenant DAO platform: an immutable Credit ledger with period-cap enforcement, a three-tier settlement cap cascade (per-rule → per-contributor → DAO-wide), and an OpenAI GPT-4o-mini-backed weekly reporting pipeline.

Technologies: NestJS, Node.js, MySQL, JWT/bcrypt RBAC, OpenAI GPT-4o-mini, DAO Tokenomics.

### Digital South Trust

Blockchain Intern, Digital South Trust. March – July 2026. New Delhi.

Architected a Certificate SaaS with org-scoped data isolation, OTP email authentication, and Stripe/Razorpay billing with plan-level quota enforcement. Designed a Polygon issuance pipeline anchoring certificate hashes and metadata URIs on Amoy through a Solidity contract, with idempotent retries and public verification.

Technologies: Next.js App Router, MongoDB Atlas, Mongoose, OTP Authentication, Stripe, Razorpay, Polygon (Amoy), ethers.js, Solidity.

### Lokachakra

Blockchain and ZKP Intern, Lokachakra (UK-based startup). June – Aug 2025. New Delhi.

Built a ZKP-based identity and KYC backend in Rust (Circom/Groth16, 10K+ users, 85% verification time reduction); engineered a cryptographically secure wallet system achieving 5,000+ TPS at sub-15ms latency.

Technologies: Rust, Circom, Groth16, Zero-Knowledge Proofs, KYC, High-TPS Engine.

## Earlier research

### Post-Quantum Cryptography Research Initiative

Software Engineer Intern - Cryptography Research. January-May 2025, remote. This earlier entry was supplied in the original portfolio; the latest LinkedIn PDF does not list it as a separate employment entry.

Benchmarked four NIST PQC finalist schemes against RSA/ECC and proposed hybrid migration strategies with 35% lower overhead.

## Selected projects

### Decomm — Quantum-Resistant P2P Infrastructure

Founder, AlterBlock / Project Builder. 2025 – 2026.

Built sovereign P2P communication in Rust with ML-KEM-1024 key exchange and per-session AES-256-GCM channels. RISC Zero zkVM Merkle proofs are anchored to Solana and validated end-to-end with real 244 KB STARK receipts. A self-run security audit found and patched two critical verifier-bypass bugs. Founder of AlterBlock.

Technologies: Rust, libp2p Gossipsub, ML-KEM-1024, RISC Zero zkVM, AES-256-GCM, Solana.

### TRIAD — AI Market Microstructure Engine

Independent Project. 2025 – 2026.

Event-driven system ingesting live Binance L2 order-book depth, computing VPIN/spoofing/order-imbalance signals with a SHA-256 commitment hash chain; ONNX inference combined with per-regime HNSW episodic k-NN memory for sub-10ms decisions.

Technologies: Rust, Python, NATS JetStream, ONNX Runtime, PostgreSQL, pgvector, HNSW.

### CODIT — Autonomous Codebase Audits

Independent Project. Dates not supplied.

Built an autonomous codebase audit platform that combines Tree-sitter static analysis with machine-learning defect-risk scoring. SHAP explanations make each risk assessment interpretable, connecting code structure to understandable audit findings.

Technologies: Tree-sitter, Static Analysis, Machine Learning, Defect-Risk Scoring, SHAP.

- [Visit CODIT](https://coditt.xyz/)

### ZK Proof-of-Reserves Vault — ERC-4626 Yield

Open Source Project. 2024 – 2025.

Full-stack ZK-verifiable ERC-4626 yield vault with an off-chain Groth16 Proof-of-Reserves pipeline and auto-generated Solidity verifier; 5 contracts deployed and Etherscan-verified on Sepolia.

Technologies: Solidity, Foundry, Circom, Groth16, Aave V3, Next.js, Sepolia.
